intro: Tuck it neatly by your sofa or bed. The Herb corner table is that small but steady companion where your lamp, phone, or favorite mug rests, making everyday moments easier and more graceful.

features.title: Walnut finish adds warmth in corners
features.text: The rich walnut tone lifts even unused corners, turning them into cozy, styled nooks that feel intentional and welcoming.

features.title: Compact size that fits anywhere
features.text: Designed to slot into tight corners or beside seating, it makes the most of your space without overwhelming it.

features.title: Easy upkeep for stress-free living
features.text: Smooth surface wipes clean in seconds, so it’s always ready for use without fuss, whether in the living room or bedroom.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Herb Tempered Glass Corner Table
